title: AI Opportunity Scorecard
description: Compare potential AI opportunities using business value, feasibility, data, ownership, risk and testability.
format: Printable HTML guide, editable CSV worksheets and contextual prompts
contents: Printable guide with an assessment framework
Editable opportunity scorecard and fictional example
Three contextual prompts and a decision record
body:
A practical working resource

Compare AI ideas, expose missing evidence and choose a useful next investigation.

Use the guide, editable worksheet and fictional example together. Download the ZIP, open the HTML guide in a browser and work in a copy of the CSV template.

What is included

  • Printable guide with an assessment framework
  • Editable opportunity scorecard and fictional example
  • Three contextual prompts and a decision record

Who it is for

Business leaders, operations teams and advisers turning an AI idea into a clear business decision.

How to use it

Complete the record with the people who perform and own the work. Keep evidence and unresolved questions visible. Use the prompts to challenge a draft, then have the relevant owners confirm the decision.

All worked examples are fictional. The material helps structure planning and review; it does not promise a particular outcome.
